input_contract.population: Patients with pathologically confirmed brain tumors or suspected gliomas, evaluated by multiparametric MRI.

quality_constraints.imaging: Multiparametric MRI including T1, T1-contrast, T2, and FLAIR sequences with standard spacing and registration.

safety.disclaimer: No model artifact is registered. This entry exists to show the coverage gap and must never produce a finding.
limitations: DEFERRED. Blocked on BraTS dataset access and computational resources for multiparametric image processing.
Planned reused implementation: nnU-Net as the segmentation backbone, MONAI for multiparametric MRI I/O and segmentation metrics.
Planned fusion of imaging features with clinical and genomic data is deferred pending P3 scope refinement.
Licensing status of BraTS and TCGA-GBM data is unverified.

model_card.intended_use: Planned: glioma lesion segmentation and grade/subtype characterization from multiparametric MRI.
model_card.training_population: Planned: BraTS and TCGA-GBM cohorts with pathologically confirmed gliomas.
model_card.evaluation_population: Planned: BraTS held-out evaluation set plus external validation cohort.
model_card.label_policy: Expert neuroradiologist annotation and pathological confirmation of tumor grade and subtype.
model_card.explanation_method: planned: per-region tumor grade/subtype inference plus feature importance

reuse_manifest.preprocessing_assumptions: Multiparametric MRI with consistent spacing and registration
NIfTI/DICOM with valid affine, multiparametric stacking
